summary: Tested five public read APIs and core desktop/mobile UI flows. APIs and navigation passed; two frontend defects found.

ui_bugs.issue: Eyebrow displays literal '{period}' instead of selected period.
Typing ICICI leaves all four rows visible; search input is not wired to filtering.

action_items: Interpolate the selected period in the Dashboard eyebrow.
Implement Facility Master search filtering against bank/facility fields.
critical_code_review_comments: Import, report export, refresh, and add-row actions currently provide only local toast feedback; they do not persist or export data as this is a mocked offline MVP.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing controlled sample data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard, all requested sidebar pages, tables, report toast, working import toast, and mobile menu were exercised. Facility search and period label need retest.
rca of the issue: Dashboard passes a literal string eyebrow="CONTROL CENTRE · {period}" rather than interpolating state. Facility search input has no value state or filtering predicate; it is presentation-only.
